question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) in relation to chemical?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) in relation to chemical refers to an analytical methodology used to analyze and quantify the environmental aspects and impacts of product systems over their entire life cycle. It involves assessing the environmental implications of chemicals used in materials, products, processes, and buildings from production to disposal, considering factors such as toxicity, resource use, emissions, and waste generation.
